name: round_half_even
hidden:
assert to_cents(1.005) == 100, to_cents(1.005)
assert to_cents(2.675) == 267, to_cents(2.675)
assert to_cents(0.1) == 10
intent: to_cents(x) converts a float amount to integer cents using banker's rounding (ties to even).

name: interval_merge
intent: merge_iv(intervals) merges overlapping or touching intervals.

name: title_case_small
hidden:
assert title('the lord of the rings') == 'The Lord of the Rings'
assert title('a tale of two cities') == 'A Tale of Two Cities'
intent: title(s) capitalises words except the small words 'of', 'the', 'a', 'and' — but always capitalises the first word.

name: lru_evict_order
hidden:
c = LRU(2)
c.put('a',1); c.put('b',2)
assert c.get('a') == 1
c.put('c',3)
assert c.get('b') == -1, 'b was least-recently-used'
assert c.get('a') == 1, 'a was refreshed by the get'
intent: LRU(cap) evicts the LEAST RECENTLY USED entry; a successful get counts as a use.

name: wildcard_match
hidden:
assert match('a*c', 'abc')
assert match('a?c', 'abc')
assert not match('a?c', 'ac')
assert match('*', '')
assert not match('a.c', 'abc'), 'a literal dot must not act as a wildcard'
intent: match(pat, s) supports '*' (any run) and '?' (exactly one char); every other character is literal.
